gold_points: Non-marketable securities are adjusted to fair value only on observable transactions or impairment (measurement alternative)
Early-stage private investments may never materialize, risking loss of a substantial part of the investment
Private company valuations are complex due to lack of readily available market data
Equity method investments generally don't fluctuate with market prices but may be impaired if carrying value exceeds fair value
output.note: Question spans both chunks: the measurement alternative is introduced in chunk 0004, while the private-company risk and equity method discussion are in chunk 0005.
output.question: In Alphabet's fiscal 2024 10-K market risk disclosures, why are its non-marketable equity securities considered riskier and harder to value than its marketable equity securities, and how are equity method investments treated differently?
